description: This PHP script handles the display and logic for the 'Call Related List' view in the vtiger CRM module 'Campaigns'. It manages retrieving campaign info, related modules, session data, and rendering the related list template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for rendering templates in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record and module.

methods.name: getRelatedLists
methods.description: Fetches related modules and entries for the current module and focus object.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Adds a related module to the session for display.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves related modules stored in the session.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Gets the sequence number field for the current module.

methods.name: CheckFieldPermission
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific fields in modules.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information for a record.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Checks permissions or conditions for UI buttons.
